Built on World of Dungeons by John Harper (free PDF on itch.io), CC BY 3.0. The same seed, class and quirk setting always roll the same character.

Backgrounds: React Bits by David Haz (MIT + Commons Clause), drawn with React (MIT) and ogl (Unlicense)

Dice: rpg-dice-roller (MIT) with math.js (Apache-2.0) and random-js (MIT); 3D dice: Fantastic Dice (MIT) with BabylonJS (Apache-2.0) and Ammo.js (zlib)

Drawing: perfect-freehand (MIT); saving in the browser: idb-keyval (Apache-2.0)

Also: the plain sheet · the free-form beta
